about_the_game:
In each level you will be asked a question or you will be given a statement. You respond by clicking on one of the two images. Challenge is usually easy, excuse for viewing Hentai.
Second part of the game is contains dark humour and dark topics. Levels with schizo voice in your head contain trick questions. You might be disturbed if you don't have 4chan experience.
You are adviced to do two runs for viewing responses for both answers to each question.

All assets are AI generated.

260 images in game are generated by AI.

200 bonus images are generated by a diversity of Checkpoints.

Music : Suno

Text to speech and sound effects: Elevenlabs
